body:
Meet the ultimate money magnet. We’ve never seen Pyrite carved like this before—and the moment we held it, we knew it was special. The Pyrite Money Sign is a bold, sculptural piece designed to elevate your wealth rituals, amplify confidence, and activate real financial magnetism.

Known as “Fool’s Gold,” Pyrite has been used for centuries as a stone of wealth attraction, energetic protection, and assertive power. But in the shape of a dollar sign, its energy becomes laser-focused—turning your space into a field of bold abundance and opportunity.

Whether placed on your altar, desk, or 528Hz Generator, this crystal broadcasts confidence, clarity, and aligned action—three keys to calling in more wealth, more flow, and more of what you truly desire.

Each piece is hand-selected and carved to hold frequency, intention, and bold visual power. Use it as a standalone energetic anchor—or combine it with our 528Hz Generator + Wealth Disc ritual to supercharge your manifestation process.
